about_the_game:
Build a thriving settlement. Watch your people grow. Every miracle costs lives.

Eurekas is a real-time colony builder inspired by Populous and The Settlers. Your settlers build, gather resources, and pray to generate mana for defense. You wield divine powers that don't cost mana—they cost lives.

Reshape terrain, summon resources, smite enemies—watch your population disappear with every spell. Meanwhile, corruption grows with your settlement and divine actions, spreading tile-for-tile.

Every choice matters: expand and watch darkness spread in response. Sacrifice settlers for immediate solutions, or preserve your workforce and struggle through threats. Explore procedurally generated islands seeking mystical foci—ancient sources of power that unlock devastating new spells.

Face intelligent monsters that corrupt strategically, growing stronger as your empire expands.

Every miracle has a price. How many will you sacrifice?

Key Features

Blood Magic & Divine Powers:

  • Life-powered spells that consume your population directly

  • Discover mystical foci across islands to unlock devastating new abilities and uncover ancient lore

Settlement & Strategy:

  • A multitude of buildings with upgrade tiers—from simple dwellings to divine temples, including terrain-specific variants across biomes

  • Autonomous settlers who live their own lives, gathering resources and praying to fuel your power

  • Strategic resource management balancing wood, stone, food, spirit, and mana economies

Threats & Corruption:

  • Dynamic creep expansion that spreads tile-for-tile with your settlement—bigger empire = stronger enemies

  • Intelligent monsters that strategically corrupt land and coordinate attacks

  • Day/night cycle with varying dangers and gameplay mechanics

Exploration & Progression:

  • Procedurally generated islands with unique challenges and mysteries

  • Multiple biomes: ocean, grass, desert, mountains, mines, and forests with distinct mechanics—more to come

  • Island-hopping campaign to grow strong enough to vanquish your ultimate foes

They worship you. You consume them. Every god makes this choice.
